leadText: (Japanese: モモヨ Momoyo) is a character who appeared in Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!.
plainText:
(Japanese: モモヨ Momoyo) is a character who appeared in Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!.

==History==
Momoyo appeared in GDZ45, where she accidentally bumped into Shu. This caused her leg to get broken and Hinako who was riding by on a made fun of her. Shu volunteered to take Momoyo's place and disguised himself as a girl.

Later, after Shu won the race and saved Hinako from falling, Momoyo laughed at Shu after he was crowned as Miss Empress.
